  (w b : NNReal → ℝ) (T : NNReal) (hT : 0 < T) (hw : ContinuousOn w (Set.Icc 0 T))

    (fun level =>
      have times :=
        AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes
          (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh T level)
          (2 ^ level);
      ∑ i,

def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.PrefixIntegral.prefixIntegral : (NNReal → ℝ) → NNReal → NNReal → ℝ :=
fun f T t =>
  ∫ (s : NNReal),
    if s < Min.min t T then f s else 0 ∂AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T

def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh : NNReal →
  ℕ → NNReal :=
fun T level => T / ↑(2 ^ level)

def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes : NNReal →
  (cellCount : ℕ) → Fin (cellCount + 1) → NNReal :=
fun delta cellCount i => ↑↑i * delta

def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo : NNReal → MeasureTheory.Measure NNReal :=
fun T => MeasureTheory.Measure.comap NNReal.toReal (MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 ↑T))
